full_prompt_en: A square monochrome pen-and-ink illustration shows a small child standing on a grassy incline while an enormous shaggy creature's head looms from the upper right. The child occupies the lower left, shown in profile facing right. Spiky hair blows outward, and a dark long coat or cloak falls to the knees over narrow legs and boots. One hand holds a short rectangular object close to the body. A small pale bird stands on the slope just ahead, its round body and fine legs drawn with only a few lines. Farther up the incline at right, a tiny dark animal silhouette stands among sparse grass. Above them, the huge creature thrusts a long scaled snout toward the center. Its nostril is a dark oval; one enormous round eye glistens under tangled hair and radiating spines. Loose wiry strands hang beneath the jaw, while dense hatch marks give the cheek a rough pebbled texture. The upper half is dark with innumerable diagonal ink strokes, like a stormy mass of hair and shadow spreading from the right. A broad untouched white opening separates the creature's snout from the small figures and gives the encounter an eerie stillness. The hillside rises sharply from left to right, its ground covered with fine scratchy grass marks and shifting gray stipple. There is no colored paint. Gray values are built entirely from line density, crosshatching, and unmarked white paper; the darkest zones lie in the coat, the animal silhouette, and the creature's upper mane. Light appears to come from the open white center, leaving silhouettes crisp against it and allowing the textured masses to taper at their edges. The extreme scale contrast between the tiny child and giant face, held across a clear gap, gives the intricate drawing a quiet storybook tension.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形单色钢笔墨线插画描绘一个小孩站在草坡上，而一只巨大蓬毛生物的头从右上方逼近。小孩位于左下，侧身朝右。尖乱头发向外飞，深色长外套或斗篷垂到膝盖，下面露出细腿与靴子。一只手把短长方形物件抱在身侧。一只浅色小鸟站在前方坡面上，圆身体和细腿只用少量线条画出。右侧更高的坡上，一枚微小的深暗动物剪影站在稀疏草中。上方，巨兽把长而有鳞纹的鼻口伸向中央。鼻孔是一枚暗椭圆；一只巨大的圆眼在纠缠毛发与放射尖刺下发亮。松散硬毛从下颌垂落，密集排线让脸颊带粗糙卵石般纹理。上半幅由不计其数的斜向墨线压暗，像头发与阴影形成的风暴从右侧蔓延。巨兽鼻口与小人物之间留一片宽阔未上墨白域，让相遇显得诡异而静止。山坡从左向右陡升，地面覆满细碎刮线草痕与变化的灰色点彩。画面没有彩色颜料。灰阶全由线条密度、交叉排线与未着墨白纸建立；最深处在外套、小动物剪影和巨兽上方鬃毛。光仿佛来自中央开放的白色区域，让剪影在其前清楚成立，并使纹理大块在边缘逐渐稀薄。微小孩童与巨大面孔之间极端的尺度对照，隔着清楚空隙，为繁密绘画带来安静的故事书张力。
style_prompt_en: Monochrome pen-and-ink drawing creates gray values through close hatching, crosshatching, stipple, and broad untouched white paper. Fine directional strokes accumulate into dense dark masses, while irregular scratch marks fray their edges. A large textured form presses against a much smaller isolated mark, with a wide blank interval holding tension between them. Angular diagonals organize the ground and upper shadow, countered by a smooth open negative field. The darkest passages have layered line depth rather than flat black fill; lighter passages depend on sparing contour and exposed surface. The result is intricate and tactile, balancing crowded microtexture with generous silence in the center.
style_prompt_zh: 单色钢笔墨线绘画用密排线、交叉线、点彩和大片未着墨白纸建立灰阶。细而有方向的笔迹聚成浓暗大块，不规则刮线又让边缘散乱。一块巨大的有纹理形态压向一枚更小的孤立记号，中间宽阔空白维持张力。斜向棱线组织下部与上方阴影，由光滑的开放负空间抵消。最深区域有叠线纵深，而非平涂黑色；较亮处依赖节省的轮廓与露出表面。整体繁密且可触，让拥挤的微肌理与中央宽敞的寂静保持平衡。
theme_en: A small child facing a giant shaggy creature on a sloping hillside
theme_zh: 一个小孩在斜坡上面对一只巨大的蓬毛生物
name: Chris Riddell
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
